raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

When an optional dependency is missing (for example `qwen_vl_utils` for multimodal data), `_process_multi_modal_info` raises `ModuleNotFoundError` inside `doc2len` for every sample. The catch-all `except Exception` in `maybe_filter_out_long_prompts`, added in #3814 to drop malformed rows, swallows it and returns `max_prompt_length + 1`, so the filter silently drops the whole dataset. Training then fails much later with an unrelated error:

```
ValueError: num_samples should be a positive integer value, but got num_samples=0
```

A missing package is an environment problem, not malformed data, so this PR re-raises `ImportError` (which covers `ModuleNotFoundError`) in both `doc2len` paths. Malformed rows are still dropped as before.

Related: #6888 moves these two functions to module level (`_filter_prompt_length_with_processor` / `_filter_prompt_length_with_tokenizer`). If it lands first, the same two lines apply there and I'm happy to rebase.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+doc2len
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

Added `test_maybe_filter_out_long_prompts_reraises_import_error` to `tests/utils/dataset/test_rl_dataset_on_cpu.py`. It patches `_process_multi_modal_info` to raise `ModuleNotFoundError` and asserts the filter raises `ImportError` instead of returning an empty dataset.

- Before the fix: `Failed: DID NOT RAISE ImportError` (captured output shows `filter dataset len: 0`)
- After the fix: passes, and all 11 tests in the file pass locally

Found while running the CPU dataset tests locally without `qwen_vl_utils` installed: `test_image_rl_data` failed with the `num_samples=0` error above.

### API and Usage Example

No API change.

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py`: add `except ImportError: raise` before `except Exception` in both `doc2len` closures (processor and tokenizer paths).
- `tests/utils/dataset/test_rl_dataset_on_cpu.py`: add the regression test above.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting) (run on the changed files; all hooks pass).
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs). Not needed: no user-facing behaviour change beyond a clearer error.
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test(s) to [the CI workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/.github/workflows) to cover all the code. The new test is in an `*_on_cpu.py` file, so `cpu_unit_tests.yml` picks it up.
- [ ] Once your PR is ready for CI, send a message in the `ci-request` channel.
- [ ] If your PR is related to the `recipe` submodule, please also update the reference to the submodule commit. Not applicable.

files.patch:
@@ -189,6 +189,50 @@ def fake_process_multi_modal_info(cls, messages, image_patch_size, config):
     ]
 
 
+def test_maybe_filter_out_long_prompts_reraises_import_error(monkeypatch):
+    class FakeDataFrame(list):
+        def filter(self, fn, num_proc=None, desc=None):
+            return FakeDataFrame([doc for doc in self if fn(doc)])
+
+    class FakeProcessor:
+        def apply_chat_template(self, messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False, **kwargs):
+            return "formatted prompt"
+
+    def fake_process_multi_modal_info(cls, messages, image_patch_size, config):
+        raise ModuleNotFoundError("No module named 'qwen_vl_utils'")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        RLHFDataset,
+        "_process_multi_modal_info",
+        classmethod(fake_process_multi_modal_info),
+    )
+
+    dataset = _mock_rlhf_dataset()
+    dataset.processor = FakeProcessor()
+    dataset.tokenizer = None
+    dataset.filter_overlong_prompts = True
+    dataset.apply_chat_template_kwargs = {}
+    dataset.tool_schemas = None
+    dataset.image_patch_size = 14
+    dataset.config = OmegaConf.create({})
+    dataset.max_prompt_length = 10
+    dataset.mm_processor_kwargs = {}
+    dataset.num_workers = None
+
+    image_path = "file:///tmp/image.jpg"
+    dataframe = FakeDataFrame(
+        [
+            {
+                "prompt": [{"role": "user", "content": "Describe <image>"}],
+                "images": [image_path],
+            }
+        ]
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ImportError, match="qwen_vl_utils"):
+        dataset.maybe_filter_out_long_prompts(dataframe)
+
+
 def test_process_multi_modal_info_keeps_event_loop_responsive(monkeypatch):
     processing_started = threading.Event()
     observer_ran = threading.Event()
